scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @mesh2param/contracts build && pnpm --filter @mesh2param/ui build && pnpm --filter @mesh2param/web build
scripts.cf:check: pnpm build:web && pnpm cf:types && pnpm cf:typecheck && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.cf:dev: pnpm build:web && pnpm cf:types && pnpm cf:typecheck && wrangler dev
scripts.cf:deploy: pnpm build:web && pnpm cf:types && pnpm cf:typecheck && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mesh2param/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @mesh2param/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @mesh2param/web typecheck && uv run --frozen --extra dev mypy engine services scripts tests
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @mesh2param/contracts generate:check && pnpm --filter @mesh2param/web lint && uv run --frozen --extra dev ruff check engine services scripts tests
scripts.test:frontend: pnpm --filter @mesh2param/contracts test && pnpm --filter @mesh2param/ui test && pnpm --filter @mesh2param/web test
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:geometry && pnpm samples:check && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm licenses:check
